title: Add a sourced, readable chess baseline
acceptance: Select and cite an exact chess rules source edition and declare the baseline's scope; distinguish that source edition from the RuleBooks record revision.
Write and review objective, board and pieces, setup, turns, movement, captures, special moves, checks, endings and draws with stable rule IDs and source locators.
Identify which play procedures, clock, conduct and competition provisions are included or outside the declared scope.
Publish the readable rules with an honest formalization status; do not require semantic implementation to complete the content task.
Create semantic work only when source review or a concrete mapping attempt reveals an evidenced limitation.

evidence.note: Chess is one of the first three readable game entries.
The source register identifies FIDE primary rules and secondary orientation material for source selection.
